questions.stem: Which of the following is true regarding the placement of ECG leads?
questions.stemHtml: Which of the following is true regarding the placement of ECG leads?

options.label: A
options.text: The earth to all leads is in the right leg.

options.label: B
options.text: Lead I: Positive pole to the right and negative pole towards the left

options.label: C
options.text: Lead III: Positive pole on the left and negative pole towards the right

options.label: D
options.text: Lead II: Positive pole on the right and negative pole towards the left
